correctness.rationale: For a gap vector (a,b,c,d), three two-one deck coordinates force any equal-deck vector to differ by t(1,-3,3,-1). Exact substitution into the three one-one coordinates shows that all remaining nonconstant coordinates agree iff t(c-b+3t)=0. Nontrivial equality therefore has the unique form b-c=3t. Orienting t>0 yields a unique two-word class parameterized by a,c,e>=0 and t>=1 with length a+e+2c+4t+3. Summing these classes gives the second rational term, while all weight-three words contribute z^3/(1-z)^4. Independent finite replay verifies every deck coordinate directly and exhaustively checks the classification in stated ranges.
